results.title: Nxled sweeps Capital 1 for first PVL On Tour win, spoils Pepito’s debut
results.description: MANILA, Philippines — The Nxled Chameleons shrugged off the absence of three-time PVL Most Valuable Player Brooke Van Sickle and cruised to their first victory in the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) On Tour, sweeping the Capital 1 Solar Spikers, 25-17, 25-23, 25-18, on Saturday at the Chavit Coliseum in Ilocos Sur. Playing without Van Sickle, who is nursing a minor right shoulder injury, Nxled made quick work of Capital 1 and spoiled the league debut of the Solar Spikers’ No. 2 overall rookie pick, Detdet Pepito. Veteran Myla Pablo spearheaded the Chameleons with a Player of the Game performance, finishing with 17 points built on 12 attacks, four blocks, and one ace. The victory improved Nxled’s record to 1-1, while Capital 1 remained winless at 0-2.
